name: Clair Piano
author: Simon Tokumine
tagline: Physical-modal grand piano, chord keyboard & tap pianist
description: Dual-core 16-partial stiff-string modal grand piano with soundboard and bridge resonance, damper and pedal physics, 87 public-domain classical pieces, Tap Pianist mode, one-finger Piano Chord mode, and 4-slot live song recorder.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp (from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments). Public-domain classical scores from the Mutopia Project.
